name: BSEL Algo Limited
about: BSEL Algo Limited engages in the infrastructure, investment, and share trading businesses. The company provides proprietary algorithmic software for trading in F&O derivatives, commodity trading, and equities. It is also involved in the development of real estate and related activities. The company was formerly known as BSEL Infrastructure Realty Limited and changed its name to BSEL Algo Limited in October 2023. BSEL Algo Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.
